nodes.label: Rule Authoring Template
nodes.rationale: Every rule is forced into the same shape (frontmatter with title/impact/impactDescription/tags, then an Incorrect example, a Correct example, and a reference link) so rules stay machine-groupable and comparable by impact.

edges.source_location: the template's required `impact` and `tags` frontmatter is what makes the taxonomy's impact-ordered grouping possible
